blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock 55+ Condos: streets and boundaries

items.t: The verified 55+ apartment condos cluster in Sunnyside Park along 152 Street and 16 Avenue in Surrey, and in central White Rock along Best Street, Blackwood Street and Everall Street — not in the gated townhouse complexes on the South Surrey fringe.

blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock 55+ Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: White Rock condos sit under City of White Rock Zoning Bylaw 2024, No. 2506 and Official Community Plan (OCP) Bylaw 2017, No. 2220, while Surrey-side condos sit under Surrey Zoning By-law, 1993, No. 12000 — the same street can cross from one bylaw set to the other.

Long-term rental-restriction bylaws are void in every strata in both cities since November 24, 2022, but a tenant must still meet the 55+ age bylaw or an exemption, and a strata may still restrict short-term rentals.

blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock 55+ Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: White Rock council meetings and city services run from the White Rock Community Centre at 15154 Russell Avenue, the same Russell Avenue corridor as Peace Arch Hospital — relevant context for a condo buyer whose municipal counter is in White Rock, not at Surrey City Hall.

Because the identified buildings are small low-rise stratas, a single roof or elevator project is spread over few owners; the depreciation report and contingency reserve fund balance matter more here than in a large tower, and neither figure is published on a municipal page.

blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock 55+ Condos: costs and taxes

items.t: Surrey's total 2026 residential (Class 1) property tax rate is $3.42731 per $1,000 of assessed value, including $1.84251 municipal and $1.58480 for other authorities; Surrey-side buildings also pay the $300.00 Capital Parcel Tax for 2026.

White Rock sets its own rates under its Annual Property Tax Rates Bylaw, 2026, No. 2581, which the City's council summary states reflects an average property tax increase of 5.04% over 2025 rates; the City publishes a residential property tax estimator on its tax page.

blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock 55+ Condos: getting around

items.t: Highway 99 runs through South Surrey to the Peace Arch border crossing, and South Surrey has two border crossings to the United States — the driving frame for condo owners on both sides of the White Rock line.

items.t: Check a specific building's lot in the City of Surrey Mapping Online System (COSMOS) on the Surrey side: Surrey administers a Flood Prone Hazard Lands Development Permit Area using its 0.5 percent annual exceedance probability flood hazard mapping, and the low Crescent Beach, Mud Bay and Nicomekl lowland ground is a different risk from the Sunnyside Park upland where these condos sit.

faq.q: Is a White Rock 55+ condo taxed and zoned by Surrey?
faq.a: No. White Rock is its own city, with Zoning Bylaw No. 2506 and its own annual property tax rates bylaw — Bylaw No. 2581 for 2026 — while a building a few blocks north in Sunnyside Park is in the City of Surrey under Surrey's bylaws and tax rates. Check which side of the municipal boundary the building's civic address falls on before comparing two otherwise similar units.

faq.q: Which 55+ buildings here are apartment condos rather than townhouses?
faq.a: The gated rancher complexes often shown in the same search are townhouses, and they are dealt with in the townhomes note for this area.

faq.q: Can my younger spouse live with me in a 55+ condo?
faq.a: Yes, under the provincial exemptions. A younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the age requirement is exempt under Strata Property Regulation 7.01, as are live-in caregivers and legacy residents who were living in the unit when the bylaw passed. The exemption is provincial, so it applies in both Surrey and White Rock buildings, but the building's own registered bylaw wording is still read on the Form B.

faq.q: Where is hospital care for these buildings?
faq.a: Peace Arch Hospital at 15521 Russell Avenue, White Rock, is Fraser Health's hospital serving South Surrey and White Rock, and it sits in White Rock itself, south of most of the Sunnyside Park condo cluster. Surrey Memorial Hospital is the larger Surrey hospital, but for a buyer in these buildings the local hospital of record is Peace Arch.
